summary: All six independent held-out VASP force-label jobs reached LSF DONE; collected outputs passed exact frozen-structure, normal-completion, electronic-convergence, and complete 47-atom force-block checks and are ready for a separately authorized exact-checkpoint prediction batch.

payload.objective: Establish whether the current AQCat25 checkpoint can be calibrated for the Fe(110) hydrogen-transfer TS/path domain before using it to accelerate the remaining C* + H* -> CH* transition-state search.
current_evidence: R1, R2, S1, S2, F1, and F2 each finished normally and reached EDIFF electronic convergence before NELM=200.
Every collected OUTCAR contains one complete 47-atom force block and each local POSCAR still matches its frozen candidate SHA-256.

The static-label maximum movable-atom force norms are 0.2843, 0.6577, 0.8083, 0.6990, 0.6983, and 0.8180 eV/Angstrom for R1, R2, S1, S2, F1, and F2 respectively; these are labels, not ionic relaxations, so no force-convergence claim is made.
The six DONE status rows, collected OUTCAR/OSZICAR files, and diagnostic results were appended to data/project_registry.sqlite3.
No AQCat25 prediction has yet been run on R1-F2, so no force-error metric or TS-domain calibration verdict exists.
payload.one_executable_step: Prepare a hash-bound exact-structure AQCat25 prediction batch for R1-F2 for user review; do not submit GPU execution without separate authorization.
payload.submission_boundary: Completion and collection do not authorize GPU execution, fine-tuning, ML-NEB reruns, VASP NEB/CI-NEB, DIMER, frequency, connectivity, or barrier reporting.
done_when: At least five disjoint held-out VASP-labeled TS-domain structures pass registered calibration metrics for the exact checkpoint and compatibility branch.
A hash-bound calibration review decides whether this checkpoint is reusable for the in-scope C*+H*->CH* path neighborhood.
Only after calibration may the strategy engine choose the least-cost VASP NEB/CI-NEB/DIMER continuation from the complete path evidence.
